storyboard_arc.setup: Isla sees her to-do list piling up, but she pauses for a quick glance at the morning grid.
storyboard_arc.disruption: Her train gets delayed, tempting her to shut her laptop and panic about the lost time.
storyboard_arc.choice: At her sunny co-working desk, Isla ignores a work notification to claim three quiet, unhurried minutes.
storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: Since Trigoku easily punishes rushed mistakes, she double-checks the grid constraints before committing to her next move.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Taking that extra moment pays off; her next task suddenly feels manageable rather than incredibly stressful.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Wrapping up, Isla holds onto this calm focus instead of letting the daily rush take back over.

captions:
Just a quick look before the real rush starts.
Isla sees her to-do list piling up, but she pauses for a quick glance at the morning grid.

No use stressing over a delay I can't control.
Her train gets delayed, tempting her to shut her laptop and panic about the lost time.

Three minutes to myself. No rushing.
At her sunny co-working desk, Isla ignores a work notification to claim three quiet, unhurried minutes.

Today has its own little rule-set — check the constraint before rushing.
Since Trigoku easily punishes rushed mistakes, she double-checks the grid constraints before committing to her next move.

Patience pays off. That worked out perfectly.
Taking that extra moment pays off; her next task suddenly feels manageable rather than incredibly stressful.

I'm keeping this calm feeling with me for the rest of the day.
Wrapping up, Isla holds onto this calm focus instead of letting the daily rush take back over.
